name: São Paulo/Guarulhos - Governador André Franco Montoro International Airport

runway.v: two runways: 10L/28R 3,700 m × 45 m and 10R/28L 3,000 m × 45 m, asphalt

ppr.v: general aviation, including air taxi, must coordinate the flight in advance with the airport: 6 hours ahead for wingspan up to 24 m, 24 hours ahead for wingspan up to 65 m
ppr.quote: As ACFT da aviação geral (inclusive TAX aéreo) deverão COOR previamente

max_aircraft.v: general aviation parks only on apron 12, with authorisation from the operations control centre, for at most 2 hours on the ground; maximum ground time 3 hours for international and 2 hours for domestic flights; taxiways S, T and U closed to aircraft larger than a B-707; TWY A (between G and apron 1) and V limited to 65 m wingspan
max_aircraft.quote: Tempo MAX de permanência no GND, FLT INTL 03 HR e FLT DOM 02 HR.

hours.v: turboprop and piston aircraft may not land or take off 0930-1300 and 2200-0200 UTC (06:30-10:00 and 19:00-23:00 local, UTC-3), except military, medevac and RBAC 121/129 operators; this rule does not apply to jets
hours.quote: AD PRB OPS LDG e TKOF BTN 0930-1300 e 2200-0200 de ACFT Turboélices e Pistão EXC ACFT MIL,

handling.v: General aviation, including air taxi, must tell the airport when coordinating which airport-accredited handling company will look after the aircraft, and what means are available to remove the aircraft after an incident or accident; a tow fork is mandatory. No handler is named
handling.quote: Empresa de handling credenciada no AP responsável pelo atendimento da ACFT

slots.v: Season W26 (25 Oct 2026 to 27 Mar 2027), GRU capacity declaration: non-regular flights must be requested at least 3 working days ahead, on the airport's non-regular operations form. Group II (general and executive aviation) may be restricted in the busiest Group I hours, no hours stated; taxi in / taxi out operation; long-stay GA positions subject to availability. The declaration does not say whether this 3-day rule covers executive or air taxi flights (ROTAER gives 6 or 24 hours' coordination for GA): ask the airport
slots.quote: Voos não-regulares devem ser solicitados respeitando o prazo mínimo de 03 (três) dias úteis
